impDef.description: Whether decoding from media types other than application/json is supported.
Whether encoding an array to media types other than application/json is supported.
The implicit character string type when an md-array encode returning clause is not specified and the format identifier is equivalent to 'application/json'.
The implicit string type when an md-array encode returning clause is not specified and the format identifier is not equivalent to 'application/json'.
The maximum length of a variable-length character string type.
The minimum lower limit an MD-axis can have.
The maximum lower limit an MD-axis can have.
The maximum number of dimensions for an MD-array.
The minimum value used as the neutral element of md-array aggregation operator MAX in an md-array aggregation expression.
The minimum value used as the neutral element of md-array aggregation operator MIN in an md-array aggregation expression.
The exponent range of an approximate numeric or decimal floating point value of an md-array aggregation expression.
The maximum number of md-axis in an md-extent.

The MD-array value obtained by decoding the result of the JSON_QUERY(SVE, 'lax $data'), where SVE is the string value expression immediately contained in an md-array value constructor by decoding, according to the format indicated by the format identifier when the md-array value constructor by decoding immediately contains a format identifier that is not equivalent to 'application/json'.
The declared exact numeric type with scale 0 (zero) of md-axis limit fixed and md-axis limit.

The value of an md-array aggregation expression when the declared type of an md-array aggregation expression is the decimal floating point type and the md-array aggregation operator immediately contained in the md-array aggregation expression is the plus sign.
The exact numeric type with scale 0 (zero) that is the declared type of the result of md-array dimension.
The exact numeric type with scale 0 (zero) that is the declared type of the result of the md-array axis index function.
The exact numeric type with scale 0 (zero) that is the declared type of the result of the md-array lower axis limit and the md-array upper axis limit.
The result of an md-array encode function when the format identifier is not equivalent to 'application/json'.
